For the accuracy-class-dependent attribute (max number of verification scale intervals), use model_level with models being accuracy classes? Or config_level with axis "accuracy_class". The axis describes configuration dimension. I think config_level with axis "accuracy_class" is apt:

```
  {
    "attribute": "maximum_number_of_verification_scale_intervals",
    "axis": "accuracy_class",
    "values": [

      {"condition": "(IIII)", "value": 1000, "unit_symbol": null}
    ]
  }
]
```
